title: Connection of hypocoercivity and hypocontractivity via the $θ$-methods
summary: Recent literature shows that hypocoercivity properties of linear evolution equations (in particular their exponential decay and the sharp short time decay of their propagator norm) carry over to their discretization via the midpoint rule. This note discusses this connection for the (other) $θ$-methods, i.e.\ for $θ\ne\frac12$. It is shown that any implicit discretization with $θ\in (\frac12,1]$ (pertaining to a hypocoercive continuous-time evolution equation) is contractive, and not only hypocontractive -- in contrast to the midpoint rule.
